_comment: The same game as opencritic-game.json, but with percentRecommended on a
0-to-1 scale instead of 0-100. Not a response anyone has seen: it is the
shape the field would take if the API ever shipped the fraction, which a
plain 0-100 range check would wave through as '0.97 percent recommended'.
No number is better than a wrong number, so the mapper withholds the row
and the run logs the suspicion once.
name: Elden Ring
